LanguageData.AEXP_Anaconda.label: wasteland indigo
LanguageData.AEXP_Anaconda.description: A gigantic indigo snake adapted to drowned streets, poisoned marshes, and the warm runoff beneath ruined settlements. Wasteland indigos are patient ambush predators that coil around prey and drag it into deep water before feeding.
LanguageData.AEXP_EggAnacondaFertilized.label: wasteland indigo egg (fert.)
LanguageData.AEXP_EggAnacondaFertilized.description: A fertilized wasteland indigo egg. If kept warm, it will hatch into a young wasteland indigo.
LanguageData.AEXP_EggAnacondaUnfertilized.label: wasteland indigo egg (unfert.)
LanguageData.AEXP_EggAnacondaUnfertilized.description: An unfertilized wasteland indigo egg. It can be eaten raw, but is safer cooked.
